summary: You offer laser and aesthetic treatments in Umm Suqeim with a clear WhatsApp path, but conflicting hours and dead buttons cost you bookings.

findings.problem: The Treatments and Appointments buttons link to #services but no services section appears. The menu parent and partner logos also link to #.
findings.cost: Buttons that go nowhere lose patients ready to book.
findings.fix: Working treatment pages and booking buttons.

findings.problem: Hours are 10 AM to 10 PM, 7 days in one place and 10 am to 8 pm in the footer. The address is Jumeirah Beach Road in one place and 571 Jumeirah St in another.
findings.cost: Patients arrive when you are closed, or doubt the details.
findings.fix: One set of hours and one address.

findings.problem: Loading... and To view this video please enable JavaScript show on the page, the logo text says Lucia Clinic Logo, and the Laser card says Strength begins with a radiant, healthy body.
findings.cost: Leftover text and mismatched copy look unfinished.
findings.fix: Clean content written for each treatment.

findings.problem: The booking form appears to lack name and phone fields. No email, no before and after, the dermatologists are unnamed, and Dubai's top clinic has no support.
findings.cost: Patients choose a clinic by proof and who treats them.
findings.fix: Complete form, named team and results gallery.

redesign: A working booking form and WhatsApp button on every page.
Named doctors, one set of hours and captioned before and after results.
